    Robotics

     

    While I have covered the complete unboxing and step-by-step assembly of this kit in my video, it’s honestly not practical to explain every single step here in the article. This kit comes with a large number of components, mechanical parts, screws, modules, and wiring connections, and going through each of them in text form would make this guide unnecessarily long and confusing.

    Unboxing Videos

    Instead of overwhelming you with too many written steps, I highly recommend watching the full video tutorial, where I have shown everything in a clear and easy-to-follow way. You’ll be able to see exactly how each part fits together, how the wiring is done, and how the final robot car is assembled which makes the whole process much simpler, especially for beginners.

    In the video, I walk you through:

    • Complete unboxing of all components
    • Identification of each part
    • Step-by-step mechanical assembly
    • Proper wiring and connections
    • Final look at the assembled smart car

    This way, you can follow along in real time and build your own robot without confusion or guesswork.

    So if you’re planning to build this project, don’t skip the video; it will save you a lot of time and help you avoid common mistakes.

    Now, once the assembly is complete, this is where things start to get really exciting…

    Autos & Vehicles

    In my video, I didn’t just stop at building the  robot; I also showed you exactly how to download the mobile application and connect it with the ACEBOTT smart car. And trust me, this part is something you really don’t want to miss.


    Discover more
    Electronics
    Chips & Processors
    Engine & Transmission

    Instead of just explaining it in theory, I demonstrated everything step by step; from installing the app, connecting it to the ESP32, and finally controlling the robot in real time. You can literally drive the car using your phone, just like a high-tech RC vehicle.

    Unboxing Videos

    And the control interface? It looks super clean and modern. You get a full control panel with directional movement, different modes, and interactive features; all designed in a way that feels fun and easy to use. The moment you start controlling it from your phone, it doesn’t feel like a simple DIY project anymore; it actually feels like a smart, intelligent robot.

    Robotics

    That’s why I strongly recommend watching the video; because seeing it in action makes a huge difference compared to just reading about it.

    Talking about the design, this robot looks absolutely amazing.

    The 4WD mecanum wheels give it a very unique and futuristic style. Unlike normal robot cars, this one can move in all directions; forward, backward, sideways, and even diagonally. When you see it moving, it instantly gives that “wow” factor.

    Autos & Vehicles

    The layered chassis design, neatly placed sensors, and compact ESP32 control board make it look like a proper engineered system, not just a random DIY kit. It’s one of those projects that looks impressive even before you power it on.

    And honestly, this is why I believe this kit is a must-have; especially for kids and beginners.

    It’s not just a toy.

    It’s a complete learning experience.

    Kids can learn:

    Basic  electronics

    Wiring and assembly

    Robotics concepts

    Programming with ESP32

    Electronic Components

    Real-world problem solving

    And the best part is; they learn all of this while actually having fun.

    Instead of just watching videos or playing games, they get to build something real; something they can control, test, and improve. That kind of hands-on experience is extremely valuable.

    Even for beginners or hobbyists, this kit is a perfect starting point to enter the world of robotics and AI-based projects.

    Robotics

    So if you really want to experience everything; from building, to controlling, to seeing this robot in action; make sure you watch the full video tutorial.

    Because that’s where the real magic happens.
